label: Relationship
description: Describes a lookup between two entities in both directions: the many-to-one side stored in a lookup field (a ticket's parent) and the one-to-many inverse shown in related lists (a ticket's child tickets). It also states what happens to referencing records when a target is deleted.
usage: Create one relationship for every lookup field.
Write label for the lookup side ("Parent ticket") and inverseLabel for the list side ("Child tickets").
Use onTargetDelete: clear for optional links and restrict when children must keep their reference.
constraints: field must be a lookup field on entity whose target equals target; each lookup field has exactly one relationship.
kind is lookup in Gate 1; onTargetDelete is restrict (block deleting targets with children) or clear (null the lookup).
Self-relationships may not form cycles; a write that makes a record its own ancestor is rejected.
Relationships never grant access: each side is filtered by the viewer's own permissions.

binding.description: Configuration object in a layer's spec catalog; not a layout node.
